proof_body:
by
  intro n p t
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.mgf, ProbabilityTheory.integral_binomial, add_comm (1 - (p : ℝ)), add_pow]
  rw [show Finset.Iic n = Finset.range (n + 1) by ext; simp]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm t, Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_pow]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : unitInterval) (t : ℝ), ProbabilityTheory.mgf (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)) (ProbabilityTheory.binomial n p) t = (1 - (p : ℝ) + (p : ℝ) * Real.exp t) ^ n
